bool isSimplePower(int x, int n) {

  if (x < 1 || n < 2) return false;

  final logN = log(n);
  final logX = log(x);

  // Calculate the logarithm of x base n

  final exponent = logBaseNOfX.round();
  final tolerance = 1e-6; // Small value for comparison with floating-point imprecision
  return abs(logBaseNOfX - exponent) <= tolerance && pow(n, exponent).isApproximatelyEqual(x, tolerance);
}

String solve(int n) {
  if (n < 1) return '';
  final List<int> digits = [];
  
  // Calculate the number of digits
  int count = 0;
  int temp = n;
  while (temp > 0) {
    count++;
    temp ~/= 10;
  }
  
  for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    int divisor = pow(10, count - i - 1).toInt();
    int digit = (n / divisor).truncate() % 10;
    
    if (digit == 4 || digit == 9) {
      digits.add(digit);
    } else {
      digits.add((digit + 2) % 10);
    }
  }
  
  String result = digits.map((d) => d.toString()).join('');
  if (result.startsWith('0')) {
    result = result.substring(1);
  }
  
  return result;
}

void _heapify(List<int> heap, int size) {
  for (int i = size ~/ 2 - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
    _siftDown(heap, size, i);
  }
}

void _siftDown(List<int> heap, int size, int index) {
  while (true) {
    final leftChild = 2 * index + 1;
    final rightChild = 2 * index + 2;
    var smallest = index;
    
    if (leftChild < size && heap[leftChild] < heap[smallest]) {
      smallest = leftChild;
    }
    
    if (rightChild < size && heap[rightChild] < heap[smallest]) {
      smallest = rightChild;
    }
    
    if (smallest != index) {
      swap(heap, index, smallest);
      index = smallest;
    } else {
      break;
    }
  }
}

void swap(List<int> list, int a, int b) {
  final temp = list[a];
  list[a] = list[b];
  list[b] = temp;
}

  if (size == 0) throw Exception('Heap is empty');
  
  final maxValue = heap[0];
  heap[0] = heap[size - 1];
  heap.removeLast();
  _siftDown(heap, size - 1, 0);
  return maxValue;
}

  int partition(List<int> arr, int low, int high) {
    int pivot = arr[high];
    int i = low - 1;
    
    for (int j = low; j < high; j++) {
      if (arr[j] > pivot) {
        i++;
        swap(arr, i, j);
      }
    }
    swap(arr, i + 1, high);
    return i + 1;
  }

  void swap(List<int> list, int a, int b) {
    final temp = list[a];
    list[a] = list[b];
    list[b] = temp;
  }

  void quickSort(List<int> arr, int low, int high) {
    if (low < high) {
      int pi = partition(arr, low, high);
      quickSort(arr, low, pi - 1);
      quickSort(arr, pi + 1, high);
    }
  }

  quickSort(nums, 0, nums.length - 1);
  return nums;

  int expandFromCenter(int left, int right) {
    while (left >= 0 && right < n && s[left] == s[right]) {
      left--;
      right++;
    }
    return right - left - 1; // Length of palindrome is right - left - 1
  }

  int start = 0, end = 0;

  for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    int len1 = expandFromCenter(i, i);        // Odd-length palindromes
    int len2 = expandFromCenter(i, i + 1);    // Even-length palindromes
    int maxLen = max(len1, len2);
    
    if (maxLen > end - start) {
      start = i - ((maxLen - 1) ~/ 2);
      end = i + (maxLen ~/ 2);
    }
  }

  return s.substring(start, end + 1);
}
